meta.name: ביתא נדל״ן / Beta Nadlan: design tokens
meta.direction: A surveyor's field sheet printed in citrus-grove green on chalk paper: hard hairlines, tabular numerals, a map scale bar measured in days, and one Jaffa-orange mark that means 'sold'.
meta.cssNaming: Expose every token as a custom property: --color-*, --font-*, --text-*, --space-*, --section-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*, --dur-*, --ease-*. Light is the default; dark applies under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) on :root:not([data-theme="light"]) and again on :root[data-theme="dark"].
meta.contrast: All ratios computed with the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance formula; the table is in design.md.

$roles.bg: Page background. 'Chalk': coastal light on kurkar limestone, a faint eucalyptus grey. Not cream.
$roles.surface: 'Sheet': listing sheets, the channels table, header once scrolled, mobile action bar.
$roles.sand: 'Kurkar': used for ONE band only, the listings section (sheets laid on sand).
$roles.text: 'Grove ink'. All body text, rules, the scale bar.
$roles.muted: Secondary text, captions, photo credits. Meets 4.5:1 on bg, surface and sand.
$roles.border: Decorative hairlines between rows, sheet outlines. Never the only cue for an interactive boundary.
$roles.borderStrong: Ink rules, scale bar, table header rule, phone-button divider in the mobile bar.
$roles.primary: 'Citrus leaf'. Fill of the WhatsApp CTA only (plus hover/active). Not used for headings or backgrounds.
$roles.accent: 'Jaffa orange'. FILL ONLY: scale-bar marker (always with an ink ring), the נמכר tag (always with ink text), ::selection. Never text on light surfaces, never a button or section background.
$roles.accentText: Orange as text, rare: the inline word נמכר in a sentence or a sold listing's status line.
$roles.accentBorder: Ring around the marker and border of the נמכר tag.
$roles.focus: Focus ring on bg, surface and sand. The 'you are here' marker, same family as the scale-bar marker.
$roles.band: 'Grove deep'. Inverse band, used exactly twice: the 14-day launch plan and the final CTA.
$roles.bandText: Text, rules and scale bar on the band.
$roles.bandAccent: The orange '14' numeral and the marker on the band (orange on grove green = an orange on the tree).
$roles.bandCta: WhatsApp CTA fill when it sits on the band.
$roles.placeholderBg: Photo placeholder fill (until real photos arrive).
$roles.placeholderHatch: 45deg hatch lines on placeholders, like a hatched parcel on a survey plan.
$roles.placeholderBorder: 1px dashed outline of placeholders and of [למלא] text markers.
$roles.placeholderText: Label text inside placeholders and [למלא] markers.

display.name: Karantina
display.use: h1, h2, the giant day numerals, the route step words, the pull quote, the wordmark. Never below 36px, never for paragraphs, buttons, tables or labels.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew
body.stack: "IBM Plex Sans Hebrew", "Assistant", "Segoe UI", "Arial Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif
body.use: Everything that is read: paragraphs, h3, buttons, labels, table cells.

utility.name: IBM Plex Mono (digits and symbols only)
utility.stack: "IBM Plex Mono", "IBM Plex Sans Hebrew", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace
utility.use: Days (יום 3), tick labels, aspect ratios, m², floor, price, phone and license numbers. Plex Mono has no Hebrew, so Hebrew letters in the same run fall back per glyph to Plex Sans Hebrew (same superfamily, designed to sit together).

display3.use: route step words, pull quote, the '8,600' figure (36px to 60px)

label.use: eyebrows, sheet location line, tag text

utility.use: tick labels, ratios, specs, photo credits (13px, the floor)

section.$note: Vertical padding (padding-block) per section is assigned in design.md; never give every section the same value.

radius.$note: Square by default. Photos, sheets, tables, placeholders and bands: 0.

shadow.$note: Only two shadows exist. Nothing else casts one.

motion.reducedMotion: All transforms and the scale-bar draw are removed; only color/opacity transitions remain, capped at 80ms; scroll-behavior: auto.

scaleBar.name: סרגל 14 הימים (the 14-day scale bar)
scaleBar.direction: Day 0 at inline-start (right in RTL), day 14 at inline-end (left). Never mirrored.

sizes.L: launch band, container width, numerals in typography.scale.numeral under the major ticks
sizes.M: hero foot and final-CTA top rule, container width, labels in utility
sizes.S: listing sheet foot, sheet width, only a caption 'יום N מתוך 14'

wordmark.suffix: נדל״ן (with gershayim U+05F4, not straight quotes)
wordmark.underline: Segmented like the scale bar: a solid bar under בית, a hollow (1.5px outline) bar under א. Height 0.07em, gap 0.1em below the baseline, 0.06em break between the two parts.
wordmark.suffixStyle: body 600 at 0.32em of the wordmark size, baseline-aligned, at inline-end of ביתא, separated by 0.18em
